features: 3MP Ultra HD Resolution: Experience sharp, detailed, and vibrant visuals with the 3MP (2304×1296) camera that delivers crystal-clear footage for enhanced security. Avoid pixelation and ensure every moment is captured in rich clarity—perfect for home monitoring.

Smart Detection Technology – Advanced human detection, sound detection, motion tracking, and instant push alerts ensure accurate monitoring. Unlike basic wifi cameras for home, it avoids false alarms from pets, vehicles, or shadows.

360° Pan-Tilt Coverage: Enjoy a full panoramic view with 360° horizontal and 66° vertical rotation, providing all-round protection without missing any angle. Control and view remotely through the ezyKam+ app anytime, anywhere.

Enhanced Night Vision & Built-in Siren: With 6 infrared LEDs, the camera delivers up to 15 meters of crystal-clear night vision even in total darkness. The built-in siren acts as an active deterrent, automatically triggering when suspicious activity is detected.

Two-Way Audio with Built-in Mic & Speaker – Stay connected from anywhere with two-way talk functionality. This Wi-Fi camera for home lets you speak and listen in real time, ideal for checking on kids, pets, or elderly family members.

PRESS TO CALL FEATURE: Unique to this model, the Press to Call button lets family members or staff initiate a video call directly from the camera—great for elderly care, kids, or quick communication from home or office.

CLOUD & SD CARD STORAGE FOR Wi-Fi CCTV CAMERA – This CP PLUS 3MP smart Wi-Fi camera offers dual storage support with encrypted cloud recording and local backup via microSD card up to 256GB (card not included), giving you flexible and secure CCTV footage storage options for your smart home or office.
Works with Google Home – Operate your CP PLUS Wi-Fi camera via voice commands, making it a smart home CCTV camera for effortless viewing.
Private Mode for Peace of Mind – Instantly disable live view and recording through the app. An essential Wi-Fi CCTV camera feature for privacy in sensitive areas.

Made in India CP PLUS Wi-Fi Camera for Home – Proudly designed and manufactured in Bharat, this cp plus wifi camera combines smart surveillance features and reliable build quality to offer the best cctv camera experience for Indian homes.
description: The CP PLUS CP-E34Q 3MP Wi-Fi PT Camera is designed to provide complete indoor security with advanced smart features. It delivers 3MP high-definition video (2304×1296) for crystal-clear clarity and precise detail. With 355° pan and 66° tilt movement, the camera ensures full-room coverage and eliminates blind spots. Its AI motion tracking and human detection system accurately detects human movement and sends instant alerts for real-time monitoring. The IR night vision captures clear footage up to 15 meters even in total darkness, while sound detection identifies sudden noises for added protection. Featuring two-way communication, you can talk and listen directly through the camera using the ezyKam+ app. Secure your footage effortlessly with cloud storage and microSD card support (up to 256GB)—ensuring safety, reliability, and round-the-clock smart surveillance.
